primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1 (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4728-4735

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: induction on d = dim(S): the base case identifies the stalks of R^qf_!M with the compact cohomology of the geometric fibre and concludes finiteness over the torsion Noetherian ring; the induction step reduces to a dense open U via base change compatibility of Rf_!M and a generic-point neighbourhood formulation; over a generic point a good-curves diagram is chosen, and a chain of sufficiency reductions (check constructibility after the finite surjective V -> U, transfer along base change, discard the quasi-finite complement Z through the relative triangle, transport across the thickening nu, discard the second quasi-finite complement Z', decompose over the normalisation pieces by the composition isomorphism) ends at the proper smooth family case with finite etale T_i -> V (source lines 4737-4826)
